# 2 Baruch Chapter 65 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**65:1** "And-those-bright-waters which-you-saw after-that: these-are-the-fountain-of-Josiah, the-king-of-Judah, who-restored-the-passover-in-his-day, and-who-renewed-the-covenant-of-the-LORD, and-who-built-the-temple-of-God-in-a-great-way."

**65:2** "These-are-the-fifth-bright-waters which-you-saw."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
